This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

[During Brave]
While this Spirit is Cost 7 or less, this Brave is fixed at zero symbols.

PC12-X02.name: Evangelion Unit-01
PC12-X02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Treat this Spirit's color as colorless, and you can destroy three opposing Spirits/Ultimates with two cores or less on them. Then, if it’s the Attack Step, besides the [Soul Core], send up to two cores from your Trash to any of your Spirits.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [A.T. Field] (When Attacks/Blocks)
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects, except those of the opposing Spirit with [Soul Core] on it.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
(Can’t Stack) When the attack of your originally Cost 6 or more “Evangelion” reduces the opposing Life, send an opposing Life to the Trash.

PC12-005.name: Moment and Heart Together
PC12-005.effect:
(Once per turn: same name) During either Attack Step, when your "Evangelion" with reduction symbols of two or more colors is summoned, you can return this card from your Trash to the Hand.

[Flash]
During this turn, you can attack simultaneously with two "Evangelion" that have the same cost. The opponent can block one of them, but the other can't be blocked (Both battles conclude at the same time).

PC12-004.name: To Shinji-Kun
PC12-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "NERV" family card with reduction symbols of two colors or more to the Hand, or deploy a "NERV" family Nexus card with reduction symbols of two colors or more, treating all reduction symbols as fulfilled. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2] (Your Draw Step)
Increase the number of cards you draw by +1. After you draw, discard a card from your Hand.
